root_cause_analysis.diagnosis: Accumulated tool contact wear has reached 248 minutes, exceeding the maximum safe tool life limit (240 min). Excessive flank friction is driving torque increases (+38%) and harmonic tool chatter, creating immediate risk of workpiece dimensional out-of-spec and cutter fracturing.

recommended_maintenance_actions: Pause CNC sequence at completion of current part indexing.
Inspect carbide cutting insert grade TiAlN on turret station #4.
Index to fresh cutting edge or install new insert assembly.
Recalibrate tool length offset sensor using laser probe.
Log tool life reset in plant MES system.
